name: Cathedral nave
desc: Vows, funerals and confrontations that need a ceiling; scale used against one person.
tags: cathedral nave, stone columns, pointed arches, vaulted ceiling, stained glass windows, rows of wooden pews, worn flagstone floor, candles on iron stands, distant altar, shafts of coloured light, incense smoke, side aisle
prose: the nave of a stone cathedral, ranks of pews running between columns toward a distant altar, pointed arches carrying the vault overhead and coloured light falling from the stained glass onto the flagstones
note: Asking for a cathedral gets the EXTERIOR facade a good share of the time; the nouns that put the camera inside are pews receding, columns to either side and the vault above. Coloured light is a thing and not a mood - name the shafts through the glass or the stone comes back flat grey. The model wants a dead-centre one-point view down the aisle, so name the side aisle or a column in foreground when you need any other angle.
